enchantments.tooltip: Dexterity +8: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Good Luck +2: This item gives a +2 Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks.
Underwater Action: This item grants the wearer the ability to breathe water as if it were air.
Protection +6: Passive: +6 Deflection bonus to Armor Class.
